scope: 下一批源图样例：沿既有身份统一，不自动认可新稿。

references.role: N10 glove weight/boxing expression only; do not copy changed head/chest
current KINETIC_CEL drawing quality only; do not copy identity/palette

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / identity-preserving mecha source refinement.
Create ONE full-body design master of Old Boxer / M02, a retired 17m autonomous boxing robot, from the actual sources.
Input 1 (M02) is the authority for HEAD, CHEST, BODY AND PALETTE. Preserve that same machine.
Input 2 (N10) supplies only the mass and blunt boxing expression of the thick protective gloves and grounded stance. Its different rounded helmet and chest are NOT the identity master.
Input 3 is the approved M01 head: use ONLY its polished KINETIC_CEL drawing quality, crisp dark contours and clean hard-shadow painted armor. Never copy its teal/gold palette, mask or crown.

Preserve M02: compact ivory helmet with short raised red center crest/block, inset dark amber sensor area, restrained mechanical cheek/jaw plates; very short neck under large broad rounded shoulders; compact powerful ivory/brown chest with small restrained red inserts; dark articulated waist; thick upper arms and protective forearm cuffs. Heavy RED knuckle armor within large ivory glove shells is the unmistakable primary feature. Fists are much heavier than agile Unbranded One, but not the orange giant fists of Social Brave King. Exactly two gloves belong to two normal arms; keep elbows and wrist cuffs readable.
Warm ivory/cream armor dominates, matte earth-brown structural pieces and shoulder cuffs are secondary, deep red gloves/crest/toe accents. Charcoal joints. No new teal/gold team wash. Make the left/right head and chest identity coherent, no anime V horns or elaborate crown, no mouthful of human teeth, no pilot cockpit.
Lower body: source M02's broad brown/ivory thighs, simple stout knee guards, massive ivory/brown shins, dark ankle mechanics and wide blunt red/ivory boxing boots. Correct hip-knee-ankle support, two complete feet, not tiny legs supporting enormous arms.
Repair history is concentrated in a few replacement panels, restrained seams, a patch plate and rubbed glove edges. Large clean paint planes remain; remove all-over random scratches/grime. No text, numbers, brand marks, icons or fake letters on patches. Veteran with dignity, not a rusted junk robot.

Pose: readable grounded neutral boxing guard, three-quarter front. Both gloves raised just below chest height and held to either side so HEAD, CHEST, ABDOMEN, ELBOWS AND BOTH FEET remain visible. Slight knee flex and firm weight on both soles, no punch foreshortening into camera. Full-body crown to sole within generous margins. One robot only, no alternate views or inset.
Match the current clean KINETIC_CEL finish: confident pressure-varying ink, large armor planes with one/two crisp cel shadows and restrained highlights. Painted mechanical illustration, no photoreal toy/PBR or noisy line hatching.
Actual transparent background, no scene, floor, smoke, aura, halo, gradients, cast shadow or checkerboard. Preserve the original M02 identity while bringing its drawing quality into the current style.
